summary: Grocy is a self-hosted household groceries/supplies management app (PHP/Slim + SQLite). It tracks stock inventory, products, shopping lists, recipes and meal plans, chores, batteries, tasks and equipment. Users authenticate via session tokens or API keys and are granted permissions through a role hierarchy. Persisted entities: User/UserPermission/UserSetting/Session/ApiKey, Product/ProductGroup/ProductBarcode/QuantityUnit/QuantityUnitConversion/Location/ShoppingLocation, Stock + StockLog (append-only journal), ShoppingList/ShoppingLists, Recipe/RecipePos/RecipeNesting/MealPlan/MealPlanSection, Chore/ChoresLog, Battery/BatteryChargeCycle, Task/TaskCategory, Equipment, plus custom Userfield/UserfieldValue/Userentity/Userobject and on-disk StoredFile. Operations: purchase/consume/transfer/open/inventory/edit stock (each journaled in stock_log with undo), shopping-list auto-fill, chore execution & assignment, battery charging, task completion, recipe consumption/copy, generic CRUD over ~30 exposed entities, plus user/session/API-key management.
